title: AuthorizationForm - Data API
description: Represents the specific version and effective dates of a form that is associated with consent, such as a privacy policy or terms and conditions. This object is available in API version 46.0 and later.

DefaultAuthFormTextId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DefaultAuthFormTextId.description: The ID of the default authorization form text to use if text isn’t available for a specific language. This is a relationship field.

EffectiveFromDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EffectiveFromDate.description: The date when the authorization form takes effect.

EffectiveToDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EffectiveToDate.description: The date when the authorization form is no longer in effect.

IsSignatureRequired.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsSignatureRequired.description: Indicates whether the authorization form requires a signature.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the authorization form.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with this customer. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

RevisionNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RevisionNumber.description: The revision number of the authorization form. For example, "rev1.21."

special_access_rules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **AuthorizationFormChangeEvent (API version 61.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **AuthorizationFormHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **AuthorizationFormOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **AuthorizationFormShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
